additional_info.subject: 0448641 - ID0448641-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R3 170001694] Charging point is faulty CRM:00472000385
additional_info.body:
Dear Tanja,
This email provides an update regarding the issue you reported concerning the outlet out of order.
We have identified the root cause of the problem as an "undefined pilot state" within the ecog module. To resolve this, we have successfully updated the ecog module to version v1.4.11.
We are pleased to confirm that this update has resolved the issue, and all outlets are now fully operational and available.
As the reported issue has been successfully addressed and verified, we will proceed with closing this ticket.
Should you encounter any further issues or have additional questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
